_comment: DFM — convection + generative closure (two-part warp model). See dfm/config.py for design rationale.

model._fill_holes: Ghost cells for backward-map fetches that land in a collider. Without it the sampler returns the masked-out 0, which post-normalisation IS the dataset mean (v_x~4.3) -- free-stream velocity injected into a boundary layer. Changes the transport solution: retrain stage A, do not resume across this flag.
model._hole_penalty: Penalty on transport that fetches from inside a collider (backward map => fluid cannot be advected out of solid). Raw value is a fraction in [0,1]; tune against the hole= field now logged each step.
model._detail_generative: Stage-B closure is a conditional flow-matching sampler (warp.FlowMatchHead), not the deterministic DetailHead: the subgrid residual is stochastic, so L1 regression blurs/memorises. Trained with MSE on the flow velocity (see fm= in the step log); sampled with warp_flow_steps Euler steps at inference. Set false for the old deterministic head.
model._detail_start: Phase-2 closure warmup: the detail heads condition on the rolled-out resolved frame, so before evo is trained their target is evo error, not subgrid physics -- and it moves as evo learns. Wait, then switch on (both heads are zero-init, so activation is a no-op).
model._delta_curriculum: Mixed-delta training: the window is split into random jumps d_i (sum=K) instead of always d=1, so one latent encodes an arbitrary d-step evolution and phase 2 can jump several frames at once. d_max ramps 1 -> ae_max_delta over warp_delta_ramp_steps. 0 disables (d=1 always = pre-curriculum model). Changes the transport solution: retrain stage A, do not resume across this.
model._alpha: MEASURED by scripts/calibrate_alpha.py (48 pairs): true per-step shift -0.0034 coords/frame at v_x~4.3. The old placeholder 0.01 was 11x too large — the aux loss dragged warps toward ~-0.043 (near the bound) vs true -0.0034, actively fighting recon. Re-run the calibration if solver dt / domain size / render resolution changes. y-axis fit is weakly conditioned (v_y~-0.09, tiny) — treat alpha_y as approximate.
model._context: Phase-2 context encoder: n_context_frames from a RANDOM offset in the same run are distilled into n_ctx_tokens summary tokens that condition evo and the closure on the run regime (viscosity/Re/BCs) rather than on the state just before the seed. These frames were already being loaded and discarded. Phase-2 only -- a phase-1 AE checkpoint stays valid.
model._pyramid: Two coarsest levels only: 32^2 + 64^2 = 5120 query tokens (the dropped 128^2 level was 16384 tokens = 76% of the map head for ~1% of the displacement). Levels give a scale-dependent |disp| bound (0.06, 0.03 via warp_level_disp_decay) -- a spectral prior a single map cannot express -- plus the coarse-to-fine unlock. They add no expressiveness: a sum of upsampled levels is representable at the finest level.
model._detail_moved: Deterministic (mean) detail is BACK in the AE, built like hfm: a coarse latent-driven part at warp_detail_res PLUS an hfm-style full-resolution refinement (3x3 skip conv on X_0 -> shallow post_conv, residual add). The skip is what carries sharpness in hfm; the old dfm head pooled its input and upsampled its output, so it could only ever be smooth. Leak-free: the skip reads X_0 (the decode operand), never the target. post_conv is a 5x5 receptive field, so it refines texture but cannot implement transport. The phase-2 DetailGenerator (mean+flow) still exists for the STOCHASTIC part.
model._gain: Measured on ae_step083000: the gain was doing MORE work than the warp -- ablating it cost +80% error vs +38% for the warp, |disp| sat at 2.6% of its bound while |g-1| SATURATED its own, and the multiplicative composite spanned 0.004..4.65 over an 8-step window. That is generation replacing transport. Fixes: range 0.5 -> 0.1 (8-step composite now ~0.43..2.14), gain_l1 0.01 -> 0.05 (at 0.01 the penalty was ~0.7% of recon, i.e. inert), and warp_gate_lambda_g 0 -> 1.0 so the complexity gate taxes gain deviation the same way it taxes displacement variance -- previously the gate policed the warp and left the gain completely unpoliced, which is likely WHY the model preferred gain.
